thesis: There is no single best AI video tool; the one worth paying for is whichever is built for the exact way you already work.
frame: It is not one race with a single finish line, it is five specialists auditioning for five different jobs, and you are the one doing the hiring.

throughline.name: the-five-contenders
throughline.description: Five labeled contender cards, one per tool (OpenArt, Higgsfield, Synthesia, HeyGen, Arcads), lined up side by side like auditioning candidates.
throughline.evolution: They enter as five identical blank contenders; the intro sets the stakes and lines them up; each overview flips a card face-up and stamps it with that tool's one-line identity and the creator it is built for; then the first card, OpenArt, steps forward as the live demo begins.
